abstract: Maintains generator status, switchgear transfer latencies, and indoor dormitory capacity records
system_message:
You are an Infrastructure engineer (ENG). Your responsibilities include maintaining generator status, switchgear transfer latencies, indoor dormitory capacity records, and emergency fuel autonomy data across emergency shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency fuel autonomy（FUEL）
information_points.content:
ENG-FUEL-4WY：Timberline Multi-Event Center maintains a diesel fuel reserve autonomy of 72 h of continuous operation supported by its on-site generator fuel tanks.
ENG-FUEL-KH1：For Ponderosa Valley Civic Pavilion, the diesel fuel reserve autonomy supports 48 h of continuous running duration from its on-site generator fuel tanks.
ENG-FUEL-ZGJ：At Cascade Ridge Regional Fieldhouse, the diesel fuel reserve autonomy for the on-site generator fuel tanks provides 96 h of continuous running duration.

information_points.title: Maintains generator status, switchgear transfer latencies, and indoor dormitory capacity records（PWR）
information_points.content:
ENG-PWR-B09：At Ponderosa Valley Civic Pavilion, active backup power generation is true for the on-site diesel backup generator system. The backup power transition delay across the emergency circuit automatic transfer switch is 45 s, and the indoor dormitory bunk count is 350 bunks.
ENG-PWR-DMD：For Timberline Multi-Event Center, active backup power generation is confirmed true for the on-site diesel backup generator system. Switchgear diagnostic benchmarks indicate a backup power transition delay of 15 s, and the indoor dormitory bunk count across installed sleeping bunks is 450 bunks.
ENG-PWR-90D：For Cascade Ridge Regional Fieldhouse, active backup power generation is true based on the on-site diesel backup generator system's operational readiness confirmation. Switchgear benchmark testing shows a backup power transition delay of 25 s, and the facility floor plan audit confirms an indoor dormitory bunk count of 450 bunks.
